correctStatements.text: At 08:30 Mireille relayed from finance that no invoices had left the pending state since the 07:45 run.
At 08:36 Okonkwo saw the billing worker logging 503 responses from the tax calculation endpoint.
Lars estimated about 1,900 invoices were queued, the largest batch being monthly enterprise accounts.
At 08:44 Sunita found that the tax vendor had released v4 of their API overnight and was retiring v3.
Okonkwo explained that the client was pinned to the v3 base path, so each call was rejected.
At 08:55 Okonkwo decided to ship a hotfix pointing the client at v4, since the schema was compatible.
At 09:12 Lars deployed the hotfix to the billing workers.
At 09:20 Mireille saw the queue draining at roughly 400 invoices per minute.
At 09:38 Sunita confirmed the queue was empty with all invoices issued and declared the incident resolved.
Lars will subscribe the team mailbox to the vendor deprecation notices.
Okonkwo owns writing a contract test that fails when the vendor API version changes.
Mireille summarised that an unannounced vendor API retirement blocked invoicing for roughly an hour.
